info.title: OniAi
info.synopsis: Rimasti separati per sei lunghi anni, Akito Himenokōji e Akiko Himenokōji (sorella gemella del primo), giunti alle superiori, finiscono per ritrovarsi sotto lo stesso tetto, nonostante il parere contrario delle loro famiglie adottive. Akiko non fa mistero dei propri sentimenti incestuosi per Akito; quest'ultimo però non ricambia i sentimenti di Akiko, pur provando per lei un amore fraterno.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Akiko moves into a school dormitory with her brother Akito, when he transfers to her school. Owing to her brother complex, Akiko has a crush on Akito. With both of them in student government, will Akiko be able to share him with the other council members?

episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: In a student government meeting, the council members discuss what they are going to call Akito. Kaoruko proposes that Akito write a short story to be published in a women's magazine. She grows concerned for him when she learns his sibling is a sister.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Kaoruko reads the latest installment of Akito's love story. She decides to stop by the dorm, where she meets the others, and asks them whether they think Akito has a sister complex. The council decides to separate Akito and Akiko into separate rooms.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Akiko is upset over not being consulted before Arisa, who claims to be Akito's fiancée, was hired as dorm manager. Later that day, Arashi proposes that Akiko and Arisa compete in a contest, to see which one of them is the better little sister to Akito.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The girls all go to find new swimsuits even though summer is still in the distance. They try frilly ones, sexy ones, and cute ones. Then, Arashi proposes a contest to show of their new goods and Akito must decide which one impresses him the most.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Akito follows Gin to the back of the school building to find out why she is acting so suspiciously. When Akito suddenly falls sick, everyone fights over who will nurse him back to health. They decide to take turns treating him how they see fit.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: During her turn nursing, Ginbe reminisces about Akito's transfer to her school and how they first met. After Akito recovers he has to choose the winner of the contest he had no idea about. What is the prize and what will the winner do with such a chance?!
